# The key drag of the timeline in camera mode: camera, light, and accessory
# keys (RemapList, RemapAccList).
load accessory .\tri.x
select camera
frame 10
camera position 1 2 3
register camera
frame 20
camera distance 30
register camera
frame 12
light direction 0.5 -1 0
register light
select accessory tri.x
frame 25
accessory position 1 0 0
register accessory
save pmm registered.pmm

select all camera
select all light
select all accessory
frame 10
drag 10 7
save pmm forward.pmm

select all camera
frame 27
drag 27 -30
save pmm back.pmm
save vmd back.vmd
